entities.summary: Derek Wayne Tennell is an American former professional football player who was a tight end in the National Football League (NFL) for the Cleveland Browns, Detroit Lions, Dallas Cowboys, and Minnesota Vikings. He played college football for the UCLA Bruins. He won Super Bowl XXVII with Dallas.
